name: Switchroom essential AC bus
summary: Identifies the auxiliary AC bus assigned to the documented essential room loads.
description: Identifies the auxiliary AC bus assigned to the documented essential room loads. An auxiliary AC distribution diagram identifies the supplies serving room services and control-support equipment. Essential, backed-up and ordinary circuits can have different source paths and operating priorities.

In a switchroom, the lighting, service sockets, charger input and room cooling may be fed from different auxiliary branches. A source change must preserve the identities of loads that require continuity. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Essential AC source” at the input and “Essential service branches” at the output. Essential designation does not guarantee uninterrupted supply.
